items.title: College Football Playoff announces expansion to 24 teams
items.summary: The College Football Playoff (CFP) Management Committee unanimously approved playoff expansion to 24 teams, beginning with the 2027-28 college football season. ESPN will continue to serve as the CFP’s broadcast partner, signing a five-year deal worth $1.7 billion.
